title: No profile enforcement
description: A real, working escape hatch. Selecting `none` means an implementation makes no conformance claim and nothing is reported as a finding. It exists because an escape hatch that does not work is an escape hatch people fork around — and a fork is worse than an honest opt-out, because it takes the user out of reach of every later fix. The engines still run and the policy still decides; only the conformance reporting is switched off.
nonConformant: Nothing. This profile makes no claim, so nothing can fail it.
